cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(bridge_sdk_probe LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${BRIDGE_SDK_PREFIX}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Supply the expected installed SDK prefix")
endif()
enable_testing()
find_package(FreeRDP 3.32.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(FreeRDP-Client 3.32.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(WinPR 3.32.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(sdk-probe probe.cpp)
target_compile_features(sdk-probe PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(sdk-probe PRIVATE freerdp freerdp-client winpr ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
add_test(NAME sdk-private-origin COMMAND sdk-probe "${BRIDGE_SDK_PREFIX}")
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_definitions(sdk-probe PRIVATE WINPR_DLL)
  target_compile_options(sdk-probe PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
  target_compile_options(sdk-probe PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endif()
